milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because the crafted acacia_trapdoor ends up in the player's inventory. The recipe (6 acacia planks → 2 acacia trapdoors) requires the player to first convert acacia logs to planks, then craft the trapdoor at the crafting table. Checking for min_count=1 since the task is to craft 'an' acacia trapdoor.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted acacia_pressure_plate ends up in the player's inventory. The recipe (2 acacia planks → 1 acacia pressure plate) uses leftover planks from the trapdoor crafting step. The item is not in the starting inventory so its presence confirms crafting.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted campfire ends up in the player's inventory. The recipe (3 sticks + 1 coal + 3 logs → 1 campfire) requires the player to first craft sticks from acacia planks, then combine with coal and logs at the crafting table. The campfire item is not in the starting inventory so its presence confirms successful crafting.
